speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass; to begin our assessment, how old are you and when did these symptoms first start?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Cancer.

While we cannot ignore the adnexal mass, your symptoms of postmenopausal bleeding in a 65-year-old woman are most concerning for endometrial carcinoma. To confirm this, I need to request an endometrial biopsy and a pelvic ultrasound to evaluate the uterine lining and the nature of the mass.
